# Demo day rehearsal

The demo for the customers is on the last Friday of the month. We do a full run-through the day before, in the same room and with the same laptop. A dress rehearsal catches what a review of the slides never does: the video that does not play, the login that expires, the sentence that takes too long.

Everybody gets a timing: five minutes for the story, ten for the live part, five for questions. One person plays the audience and asks the awkward questions. Nerves are normal; repeating the sequence until the transitions feel natural is the cure.

After the rehearsal, write down three fixes and apply them before the real thing.
